component.name: Neodisk
component.summary: See what takes up space on your disks

description.p: Neodisk scans a disk or folder and shows where the space goes, as a cushion treemap or a sunburst, next to an outline of the largest folders and files.
Neodisk is read-only by design: it never changes or deletes your files. Open them, show them in your file manager, or copy their path, then clean up with the tools you already trust.

ul.li: Fast parallel scanning with live progress
Cushion and flat treemaps, and a sunburst view
File-kind and age statistics that color the map
Fuzzy search over every file in the scan
